ledger.title: Evidence Ledger
ledger.searchPlaceholder: Search evidence by keyword, entity, or legal claim…
ledger.emptySub: Submit evidence, or broaden your search query.

upload.heading: Upload Evidence File
upload.body: Upload a document, screenshot, or official record. Our AI will extract the text using vision, classify it, and return a draft analysis for your review before anything is registered on-chain.
upload.dragDrop: Drag & drop file here, or click to browse
upload.fileTypes: Supported: JPEG, PNG, PDF · Max 10 MB

review.heading: Review AI Analysis
review.body: Review the AI's classification below. You may edit the category, entity, and tier before registering on-chain.
review.dateHint: The date the evidence was created, published, or occurred (YYYY-MM-DD). Required.
review.irrelevantWarning: The AI has flagged this evidence as not relevant to the lawsuit. You may still register it if you believe this is incorrect.

contact.heading: Evidence Secured
contact.message: If this goes to trial, our legal team might need to verify this with you discreetly. Leave an email or phone number (optional).
contact.consent: I consent to the Privacy Policy and allow the legal team to contact me for trial purposes. My data will be encrypted and will not be shared publicly.

params.title: Argument Parameters
params.entityPlaceholder: e.g. Ministry of Health, FDA, Pfizer…
params.entityHint: The entity to build the argument against.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.step1: 1. Retrieves top Tier 1 & 2 evidence filtered by your selection.
howItWorks.step2: 2. Passes the evidence corpus to a Senior Litigator AI agent.
howItWorks.step3: 3. Returns a formal argument with on-chain citations.

empty.text: Select a legal category and target entity, then click Draft Argument to generate a formal legal argument from the evidence vault.

timeline.emptySub: Submit evidence with dates, or remove the entity filter.
